c. 1948, February 11
The following is a faithful transcription of the typed message on a Post Card by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
Bles'd be God! Febr. 11
Bles'd be the Immaculate Conception!
God bless our Friends the Doyls - trying their hand at ... I almost said - being "Fronteer-cowboys". Would likd to be with you. Well I was just talking with our Friends Joe and Win. who thank God, seem to be brightening up consiterably. I made a proposition to them that seemed to appeal as quite favorable. We must get our Bl. Mother Mary and St. Joseph positively in- terested -- in a way we must try and shift the responsitility for real success more to their loving sholders. etc. But about this, more another time. . I understand your weather down there is not too balmy. Glory be to God, however, sure its the loving Who is sending it. It must be for the best.
Congratulations to Peter at least, that he don't have to plow throuth ten to twenty-foot snow-drifts as he probably had to do 25 years ago, and as I did more or less sixty years back, 1888-9, in trolly service at the head of the Lakes. How merci- ful the good God has been to us -- always fitting "the back to the burden, if not vice versa, as often seems the case. . . ·
Fr. Solanus, O. F. M. C.
Praised be Jesus, Mary and Joseph
(received with the O'Donnell letters, Mrs. Peter Doyle was the sister of Joseph J. O'Donnell)
